北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天阳光正好，体感舒适，户外活动很棒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing enjoys sunny and pleasant weather today, perfect for outdoor activities!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，湿度较高，出门记得带伞，注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool with high humidity. Remember your umbrella and stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感微凉，湿度大，记得备件薄外套，保持好心情。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels cool with high humidity. Bring a light jacket and keep a good mood.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州大雾弥漫，体感闷热潮湿，请小心驾驶，注意防潮哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is very foggy, humid, and muggy. Please drive carefully and mind the dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感稍热且潮湿，多补充水分，注意通风。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels warm and humid. Drink more water and ensure good ventilation.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天微凉，湿度较大，出门别忘了带伞，注意防潮。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and slightly cool with high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella and mind the dampness.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感舒适，湿度高。开窗通风，保持室内干爽。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and comfortable, but humid. Remember to ventilate and keep indoors dry.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感舒适，风力较小。享受这舒适的一天吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and comfortable with light wind. Enjoy your pleasant day!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感闷热潮湿，多喝水，注意防暑和防潮哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, muggy, and very humid. Drink plenty of water and mind the heat and dampness.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感舒适。虽无阳光普照，也是美好一天。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and comfortable. Even without full sun, it's a lovely day.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感炎热，请多饮水防暑，保持清爽。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels hot. Drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke and stay refreshed.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阳光灿烂，体感舒适。尽情享受这美好的晴天吧！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and comfortable. Enjoy this beautiful clear day to the fullest!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感舒适但略干燥，记得多喝水，滋润一下。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and comfortable but a bit dry. Remember to drink more water and stay hydrated.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感舒适。正是踏青郊游的好时节！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and comfortable. It's a great time for spring outings!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门小雨绵绵，体感闷热潮湿，出门带伞，小心路滑哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has light rain, feels muggy and very humid. Take your umbrella and watch out for slippery roads.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云风大，体感较凉。记得多穿衣物，小心感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and windy, feeling cool. Remember to layer up and avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连大雾，体感湿冷风大。多穿保暖，驾车请务必小心。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is very foggy, damp, cold, and windy. Dress warmly and please drive slowly and carefully.
